profile.name: Jayditch Balansi
profile.title: Full-Stack Developer & AI Automation Engineer
profile.summary: Full-stack developer with over four years of experience building and maintaining scalable web applications and automation systems. Strong focus on backend development, API integrations, workflow automation, and AI-assisted tools.

experience.summary: Worked on high-traffic internal platforms focused on content moderation, HR systems, lead generation, and workflow automation.

projects.name: Content Moderation Platform
projects.description: Developed a high-performance content moderation system that connects clients, AI services, and human moderators to review text, images, and videos.
responsibilities: Built scalable backend systems for content review workflows
Integrated AI APIs for automated content flagging
Implemented real-time communication using Redis and Socket.io
Acted as project maintainer and participated in technical decision-making

projects.name: NMS Apps — Enterprise HRIS Platform
projects.description: Company-wide HRIS built as a single Laravel + React platform split into three business domains: Human Resources, Attendance & Timekeeping, and Payroll & Finance. Serves the entire organization for employee records, biometric attendance, and Philippine-compliant payroll.
projects.role: Core developer and maintainer, contributing major features across all three domains.

modules.name: Human Resources
features: Employee 201 file management, company directory, departments, sections, ranks, and job-title settings
Organizational chart, employee grouping with tags, and dynamic custom form fields that let HR extend employee records without code changes
Leave credits, special leaves, and monetized leave handling
Offenses, policies, and automated document mailing with configurable templates
Help desk, knowledge base, patch notes, and patient chart modules
Activity and user-log auditing across the platform

modules.name: Attendance & Timekeeping
modules.description: Biometric time capture through validated attendance records.
features: Biometric/RFID time-log ingestion that processes raw device logs into validated attendance records via queued jobs
Roster and schedule management with bulk upload and export
Timesheets, breaksheets, tardiness, and overbreak tracking
Filing and approval flows for overtime, rest-day work, leaves, suspensions, AWOL, and NCNS
Cut-off automation that closes, recomputes, and unlocks attendance periods on schedule
Time-log validator with automated Telegram and email notifiers that flag missing or malformed logs before payroll runs
IP whitelisting and off-premise time-log detection

modules.name: Payroll & Finance
modules.description: Philippine-compliant payroll computation, statutory reporting, loans, and payslips.
features: Payroll computation engine covering gross pay, night differential, overtime, rest-day, and holiday pay, with strict timezone handling for holiday overtime and rest-day boundaries
Statutory Philippine contributions and reporting: SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG/HDMF, and BIR withholding tax with versioned contribution tables
13th-month pay, last-pay/final-pay computation, payroll adjustments, and payroll movement reporting
Full loan module: loan types, settings, amortization schedules, max-loanable rules, signature prerequisites, and a dedicated loan-status page with Telegram notifications
Payslip generation with automated Telegram payslip distribution, payday scheduling, and annual/comparative-year summaries
Government-mandated and internal reports with Excel and PDF export pipelines

responsibilities: Architected shared foundations used by all three domains: role- and permission-based access control, OAuth SSO, queued jobs, Redis caching, and a reusable Excel/PDF report-export layer
Designed scalable database schemas for employee, attendance, and payroll data
Ensured secure handling of sensitive personnel and payroll information
Optimized heavy queries for efficient data retrieval across large attendance and payroll datasets
Integrated AI and workflow automation through assistant modules, an n8n client API, and Telegram-based notification delivery

projects.name: Recruitment System — AI-Assisted Hiring Platform
projects.description: Applicant tracking and hiring platform with an AI resume-screening layer that scores candidates against per-job-title skill configurations and surfaces a hiring recommendation to recruiters.
projects.role: Backend contributor on an existing platform (not built from scratch); owned the AI resume-screening pipeline end to end and the service-to-service integrations.

modules.name: AI Resume Screening
modules.description: Asynchronous CV analysis and candidate scoring.
features: Asynchronous CV analysis pipeline: a queued job submits the resume to an AI agent API and stores the returned request ID and status URL, while a polling job retries on a 30-second backoff up to 10 attempts until the analysis resolves
Batch resume analysis with guard rails that reject applicants already mid-analysis and job titles whose scoring configuration is inactive, returning actionable conflict responses to the UI
Per-job-title scoring configuration: skill rating categories, weighted score percentages, and configurable recommendation-level bands that map a score to a hiring recommendation
Audit log capturing every manual score override with its previous value, new value, and the reason given
Candidate sorting by AI score percentage so recruiters can triage a batch by fit
Interactive Artisan setup command that provisions the AI agent step by step: application token, tenant creation, agent template fetch, agent registration, and verification
Explicit failure-state handling for failed analyses, max-attempts-reached, and malformed AI responses

modules.name: Backend & Integrations
modules.description: Applicant pipeline features and cross-system integration.
features: Queued service handshake syncing departments and job titles between the recruitment platform and the HR system
External client API letting partner systems create and update departments, job titles, interviewer bookings, and applicant statuses
Applicant-pipeline features: application form settings, salary range configuration and validation, re-apply periods, blacklisting, job tags, and multi-language job titles
Refactored applicant fetching and dashboard statistics into single reusable queries to remove duplicated logic and reduce query load
Digital signature capture on offer documents and embedded exam results for assessment review
Supervisor queue worker running the analysis pipeline in production, added while assisting the DevOps team on the deployment side

projects.name: NMS Accounts — Centralized Identity & SSO
projects.description: Central identity provider for the NMS platform ecosystem: a Laravel Passport OAuth2 server handling single sign-on, token issuance and revocation, per-platform access requests and approvals, device tracking, master-password overrides, breach-checked password policies, and the roles and permissions that client platforms consume over an API instead of reimplementing.
projects.role: Full-stack contributor (not sole author): account management and RBAC features, support tooling, and deployment configuration assisted alongside the DevOps team.

modules.name: Account & Access Management
modules.description: Administrator tooling for accounts, roles, and permissions.
features: Manual account creation for administrators built end to end: validated form request, repository and service layers, a new v2 API endpoint, and the React dialog driving it
Multi-select role filtering on user management with a matching permission and query scope, letting admins slice large user lists by several roles at once
Fixes for account updates carrying role changes, plus a service method exposing roles to the core platform over the API
Editable profile fields propagated through to the data server, with corrected loader and status flows

modules.name: Support Tooling & Deployment Assistance
modules.description: Support tooling, plus production configuration worked on in an assisting capacity.
features: In-app support ticket submission posting into the resolve ticketing system, including route, permission, icon, and page wiring
Assisting on deployment, helped trace SSO failures back to a virtual host setting and extended the config to serve the platform across two domains
Helped keep the Docker image and CI pipeline in step with the core platform, including unblocking dependency installs in the build

projects.name: Resolve — Ticketing & Workstream Platform
projects.description: Internal ticketing and workstream platform built on Laravel 12 and Filament 4 with a public Livewire portal. Covers ticket intake and tracking, kanban workstreams, sprint boards, effort tracking, department routing, and an external API that other NMS applications file tickets into.
projects.role: Led the APPLICATION development from scratch and is the top contributor; owned the domain model and the full feature arc. Scope note: application development only — the CI/CD pipeline and Kubernetes infrastructure were built and owned by the DevOps team, where he assisted and contributed rather than leading.

modules.name: Ticketing & Workstreams
modules.description: Core ticketing domain, public portal, and board tooling.
features: Core ticketing domain designed from the ground up: tickets, groups, history, sources, and origins, with typed enums for status, type, prioritization, and weight, alongside migrations, factories, and seeders
Public-facing Livewire portal where anyone can submit and track a ticket without an account, including a rich text editor and file attachments
Filament admin panel with custom branding, ticket management, and admin-side file viewing and upload
Kanban workstream boards and sprint boards with per-board access control, plus a scheduled job promoting expired sprint tickets back to the backlog
Effort tracking through a Livewire timer with an exporter for reporting
Shareable public links for ticket groupings so stakeholders can follow a set of tickets without an account

modules.name: Routing, Notifications & Integration
modules.description: Assignment logic, notifications, SSO, and the external API.
features: Department-based ticket routing that assigns a ticket to every member of a department role and records the assignment in ticket history
Ticket history tracking with email notifications on creation, assignment, and resolution, queued through Redis
Email OTP verification flow for the public portal, with domain-allowlisted login
NMS Accounts v2 SSO integration across multiple domains with a dual sign-in path (Resolve account or NMS account), including first-login linking and redirect handling
External ticket API secured by a shared-secret header, addressing tickets by public reference, with published API documentation
Developer README letting new contributors run the whole Docker stack through a Makefile without local PHP, Composer, or Node

responsibilities: Application-level configuration such as environment variables, mailer setup, and Redis queueing, assisting the DevOps team that built and owns the CI/CD pipeline and Kubernetes deployment

projects.name: Lead Generation System
projects.description: Built a platform to automate collecting, managing, and tracking leads from multiple channels.
responsibilities: Implemented lead validation and deduplication logic
Designed database schema for filtering and segmentation
Integrated Google OAuth for authentication

projects.name: Automation and AI Systems
projects.description: Developed automation workflows to replace manual processes using n8n and AI integrations.
responsibilities: Built automated workflows for biometric validation
Integrated fine-tuned AI models to improve accuracy
Reduced manual intervention and processing time

projects.name: AI Image Generator and Editor
projects.description: Developed an AI-powered image generation and editing platform using third-party AI services.
responsibilities: Integrated AI image generation using text prompts
Implemented region-based image editing using brush and bounding box selection
Built an image gallery for AI-generated content

projects.name: Instagram Reels Data Fetcher
projects.description: Built a system to search Instagram users and fetch associated Reels content using official and third-party APIs.
responsibilities: Integrated Meta API for Instagram user search
Fetched and displayed Instagram Reels data
Optimized API calls for performance and rate limits

projects.name: Social Media Platform
projects.description: Maintained and enhanced a social media system with video and file streaming features.

projects.name: ERP System
projects.description: Contributed to the development and enhancement of an ERP system.

notes.devops_positioning: Not a DevOps engineer. Infrastructure and deployment exposure (Docker, CI/CD, Ansible, Apache, Supervisor, AWS) was learned by assisting the DevOps team, not by owning that role. Describe it as assisting or learned-on-the-job, never as a DevOps specialty.
